name: Reward Prediction Error Circuit
short_description: Compares expected and actual reward values, discounted by temporal delay, to generate dopaminergic learning signals that update action values.

components.name: VALUE_PREDICTOR
components.description: Maintains temporal-difference estimates of reward value for states and actions

components.name: REWARD_COMPARATOR
components.description: Computes discrepancy between predicted and received reward

components.name: TEMPORAL_DISCOUNTER
components.description: Applies temporal discount to expected reward based on delay

components.name: LEARNING_RATE_CONTROLLER
components.description: Modulates learning rate based on reward uncertainty and context

key_references: Schultz, W., Dayan, P., & Montague, P. R. (1997). A neural substrate of prediction and reward. Science, 275(5306), 1593–1599.
Montague, P. R., Dayan, P., & Sejnowski, T. J. (1996). A framework for mesencephalic dopamine systems based on predictive Hebbian learning. The Journal of Neuroscience, 16(5), 1936–1947.
design_implications: Immediate, certain rewards are more motivating than delayed rewards; in behavior change contexts, provide early positive feedback and visible progress markers
Prediction errors (surprises) are more reinforcing than expected outcomes; use variable reinforcement schedules in engagement designs
